messages.subject: Is there any way to create subfolders on our shinyapps professional server?
parts: Hello. We have the shinyapps server professional version. We have a number of shinyapps developers using it. Right now everyone just logs in and uploads their application. It seems that everyone has access to everyone else's work. Is there a way to created subfolders with permissions so that users only have access to their own work? Thanks.
